name: Syed Moiz
valueLine: I build and operate AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines and the automation that keeps production calm.
now: DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure at Keenu, working on infrastructure operations, production systems and service reliability.
about: I am a DevOps and Infrastructure Engineer at Keenu, where I work on infrastructure operations, production systems and reliability.

Before that I built and maintained cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines across AWS and Azure as a Cloud Data Engineer at SEBKO Solution, and supported Git workflows, CI/CD and governance on an agentic AI project at Omdena.

Outside work I build small, honest tools around the problems on-call engineers actually hit: failed queue messages, noisy logs, broken CI runs and risky network paths. Each project below says plainly whether it is a prototype, a hackathon build or a learning exercise.

principles.title: Safe by default
principles.text: Dry runs first, explicit flags to mutate, and a human in the loop for anything destructive.

principles.title: Evidence over vibes
principles.text: Deterministic checks before AI suggestions, and real metrics instead of made-up numbers.

principles.title: Narrow doors
principles.text: Least-privilege IAM, one security group per role, and no SSH from the internet.

principles.title: Cost is a feature
principles.text: Pay for the expensive path only when the cheap one is unsure.
